An installation runs Spinbox `v20261025.01`, the newest release spin-terraform-aws's `images.json` has images of. It is made of:

| Part | Release | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| spin: the control plane, the runner, the proxy and the CLI | `v20261025.01` | spin-terraform-aws's `images.json` |
| spin-machine: QEMU, the guest kernel, the firmware and the base image a workspace boots, as one artefact | [`v20261014.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-machine/releases/tag/v20261014.01) | spin's `versions.yaml` at `v20261025.01` |
| The OpenTofu module, spin-terraform-aws | [`v20261025.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-terraform-aws/releases/tag/v20261025.01) | its newest release tag |

The versions of QEMU and the guest kernel in spin-machine `v20261014.01` are its own [`versions.yaml`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-machine/blob/v20261014.01/versions.yaml) at that tag. The host's kernel is the Spin OS image's: none of the sources this site is generated from records its version.

## Spin OS images

Each machine boots the image of its role, in a region that has all three ([Spin OS images](/reference/terraform/images/)):

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-00cb2d0feffe89588` | `ami-0ac882e2869f704f9` | `ami-090fbe7203af7a8bd` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0ae9395569c631c81` | `ami-02b2c9c828e4db70d` | `ami-06f1c0680dcd7ea96` |
